Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted “older” by comparing the directors’ ages at their films’ release dates (37 vs 31) instead of their birth years. Using birth years, Nunzio Malasomma (1894) is older than Don McGuire (1919), so One Minute to Twelve has the older director; the final conclusion incorrectly favored Johnny Concho.
